This entry also closes the outstanding build-failure block left by the prior
sign-off (ff38d98, range 8e6c54b..a3ad2ba). That entry passed eval and drift
comparison but its closures did not build: the hyprland v0.56.1 flake
input's hyprland-guiutils/hyprtoolkit chain failed against
nixpkgs-unstable 6774f7b because hyprutils 0.14.0 was older than the
0.14.2 hyprtoolkit required. Commit 4053334 is the fix — it drops the
`hyprland` flake input entirely and switches both hosts to
nixpkgs-unstable's own hyprland 0.56.2 / xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland 1.4.1
via `lib/pinned-pkgs.nix` (`programs.hyprland.package` /
`portalPackage` set with `mkDefault`), removing the version-skew source.

Build evidence confirming the fix actually builds, not just evaluates:
- sweet16: the implementer reported a full local toplevel build succeeded
  (`/nix/store/ddilmamnbm1a3xw3saky8gi0z18i96gy-nixos-system-sweet16-26.05.20260717.293d6ab`,
  after retrying past one flaky unrelated python3.14-mcp-1.29.0 test
  failure). `nix build --impure --dry-run` on the sweet16 toplevel at
  4053334 in this session produced empty output — nothing left to build or
  fetch, i.e. the toplevel is already fully realized in the local store.
- petunia: `nix build --impure --dry-run` on the petunia toplevel at
  4053334 shows 650 derivations to build and 1166 paths to fetch, but the
  only `hypr*`-named entries in the "will be built" list are small
  host-specific glue derivations (fish-completions, systemd unit/service
  files, the Hyprland security-wrapper, hm_hypr*.conf) that always rebuild
  per-host composition regardless of the underlying package. The core
  packages themselves — hyprland-0.56.2, hyprlock-0.9.6, hyprpicker-0.4.7,
  hyprsunset-0.4.0, xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland-1.4.1, and their hyprutils/

  in neither the "will be built" nor the "will be fetched" list, meaning

  fetched from cache, no hypr* drv in the build list). No hyprtoolkit /

Both drifted hosts are confirmed buildable against nixpkgs-unstable
